App. XMate is so much better

Just needs some tweaking. Overall a very good app, I’ve seen in the recent comments you guys are working on the rambling problem and trying to fix where the app will take off on running like it did with weird metaphors and etc.

But if I may suggest something that would be a please make it to our individual characters that we created we could edit them after we have created them. Because it would be nice if we realized we wanted to change something or switch a picture out or etc we could do that without having to make another one and have two or more of the same character. 

And on the messages from the chat bot if it would be possible for us to also edit what it said in case you want to just tweak what the chat bot said or turn it to fit what’s going on in the conversation better kind of thing

Overall I’m very happy with this app I personally would like to see these three tweaks happen and I know it will be a very good app thank you.

Wish I knew how the coin system worked. I’ve been looking for an interactive app to take up my time while I’m not doing anything. This AI is great, can keep a good conversation going and everything but I didn’t realize it was based on a system of using coins per message.and there’s no specification on weather or not users get more coins per day or what, so I’m not even sure if I can continue to use it because of the coin system in place or why it’s even there at all. An answer to these questions would be appreciated as it’s otherwise a decent AI to use but you can only send like 5 messages before your promoted to buy coins to keep talking.
Love it. Love that there’s no email, payment and I can just talk…
This is awesome. It feels like I’m taking to a real person I love it
